# Repository context

L’Ayalga is an AI hospitality coordinator for shared homes. Strands coordinates
work; deterministic services and PostgreSQL own consequential booking state.

The [documentation index](../docs/README.md) lists the current guides. The
hackathon submission material is archived in
[docs/archive/hackathon](../docs/archive/hackathon/README.md); it describes the
demo as of 2026-10-14, not current behavior.

For implementation, [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)
contain the project workflow and local verification commands.
